title: The very important plum
context: An original fictional visual vignette; no historical event is asserted.
drawing: Flat color animation with soft closed silhouettes. People have oversized rounded heads, compact solid trunks, and broad rounded arm and leg shapes that carry visible mass. Small paddle-shaped hands and blunt feet finish the silhouette. Two upright dark pill marks are the only facial marks: no mouth, nose, brows, pupils or eye shine. Clothing covers the body normally, with no anatomy visible through fabric. Read emotion from posture, head angle and pauses. Use quiet edges and limited shading; avoid glossy toy surfaces and mechanical additions.

cast.lead: Ruk is a tall adult gatherer with a filled white rounded head, two dark upright pill eyes and a wide dark shaggy hair silhouette. A tan asymmetric hide wrap with a rust patch covers a solid narrow torso. Broad charcoal arms and legs end in charcoal paddle hands and rounded bare feet. A small pale shell hangs from a short cord. No eyebrows, nose or mouth.

props.item: One oversized purple plum with a short green stem, a deliberately fictional comic prop.

exclude: Hairline arms or legs, empty ring heads, extra facial marks, cloned people or objects, anatomy showing through clothing, unrequested lettering, watermarks and brand marks.

shots.setting: An ochre rock shelter with a low stone ledge, muted green shrubs beyond the opening and amber firelight on rough stone. The events are an invented visual joke.

beats.action: A medium wide view shows Ruk noticing the oversized plum with an exaggerated but mouthless head tilt.
Ruk cups the plum with the right hand and lifts it; the wrist and elbow remain thick filled shapes.
Ruk pauses with the plum at chest height, leans back slightly under its imagined weight, and stays perfectly still for the final beat.
